display_long_description:
Enter Infinite Doors, a multiplayer VR horror adventure built for players who love suspense, teamwork, and unpredictable scares. 🚪👁️ Every door opens into a new room, but you never know what is waiting on the other side. It could be a safe hallway, a useful item, a locked path, or an entity watching from the dark.

Play with friends, use voice chat to communicate, and work together to survive each run. 🔦 Search rooms for keys, tools, currency, and clues while avoiding dangerous creatures that react in different ways. Some may chase you, some may hide, and some may only move when you are not looking. Stay alert, listen carefully, and keep your team close.

Each run is designed to feel different, with randomized rooms, spooky events, interactive puzzles, and moments that force you to think fast. 😨 Whether you are opening doors, hiding from monsters, exploring strange rooms, or trying to reach the next major encounter, Infinite Doors keeps the tension building.

Customize your experience with cosmetics, discover new items, and push deeper into the unknown with every attempt. 🛒✨ The farther you go, the more intense the game becomes. Darkness, sounds, and sudden surprises can turn even a simple room into a terrifying moment.

Do you have what it takes to survive the endless doors? Gather your friends, grab your flashlight, and step inside… but remember: not every door should be opened. 🚪🔦
